title: The Fast Trick to Multiply Any Number by 25
description: Divide by 4, then multiply by 100 — a shortcut that makes multiplying by 25 almost instant.
narration_lines: Divide by 4 first. 48 divided by 4 is 12.
So 48 times 25 is 1200. Divide by 4, then times 100.

params.footnote: ÷4 then ×100 — because 25 is a quarter of 100
